title: Pi MCP overrides
description: Set global defaults and per-server controls without changing shared server definitions.

defaults.description: Apply these controls only when a server does not define them.

servers.description: Override controls for existing servers with these exact names.

exposure.description: Control how the model can call this server's tools.

toolExposure.description: Set exposure for exact tool names or patterns with *. Exact names win; the first matching pattern wins.

enabled.description: Connect to the server when true. Do not start it when false.
